en.headline: Police record nearly 18 per cent rise in ransomware cases as AI aids attacks
en.dek: Technology crime fell overall in the first nine months, but ransomware rose while police used their AI engine in an Interpol operation that took down more than 50,000 malicious sites.
body: Hong Kong police recorded a nearly 18 per cent rise in ransomware cases in the first three quarters of 2026 even as overall technology crime declined, with officers linking the increase to artificial-intelligence-aided attacks.

Chief Superintendent Raymond Lam Cheuk-ho of the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau said police had seen AI agents and other forms of artificial intelligence used in cyberattacks as recently as last month. He noted that AI increases the speed, volume and intrusiveness of attacks, making them more effective.

In the first nine months the force recorded more than 21,000 technology crime cases, down about 11.5 per cent year on year, with losses of about HK$3.9 billion, a fall of roughly 15 per cent. Ransomware cases rose to 40, while system-intrusion cases fell. Network threat intelligence items targeting Hong Kong rose about 32 per cent.

Police have adopted a “technology against technology” approach. From July last year to June this year they worked with Interpol using their AI analysis engine Project Rapid; the operation identified and led to the takedown of more than 50,000 malicious websites across dozens of jurisdictions. Officers said they would continue developing more AI tools to counter the evolving threat.

zh.headline: 警方錄得勒索軟件個案近升一成八 人工智能助攻
zh.dek: 首九個月科技罪案整體下跌，惟勒索軟件上升；警方以自主AI引擎聯同國際刑警行動，下架逾5萬個惡意網站。
body: 香港警方表示，今年首三季勒索軟件個案按年近升一成八，儘管科技罪案整體數字下跌，並將升幅與人工智能輔助攻擊有關。
網絡安全及科技罪案調查科總警司林焚豪指，警方留意到近期有不法分子利用人工智能代理及其他人工智能技術發動網絡攻擊，最快上月仍有個案。他表示，人工智能明顯加快攻擊速度、增加數量及入侵能力，令攻擊更有效。
首九個月錄得逾2.1萬宗科技罪案，按年跌約11.5%，損失約39億元，跌約15%。勒索軟件個案升至40宗，入侵系統案件則下跌。針對香港的網絡威脅情報按年增加約三成二。
警方採取「以科技應對科技」策略。去年7月至今年6月聯同國際刑警，運用自主開發的人工智能分析引擎「Project Rapid」展開行動，成功下架逾5萬個惡意網站，並與多個司法管轄區分享情報。警方表示會繼續研發更多AI工具應對不斷演變的威脅。
